alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced adding 10 mM DTT in 200 mM ABC and incubated for 1 h at 37°C, alkylated with iodoacetamide (20 mM IAM, at RT for 30 min in the dark), digested with trypsin at 37°C, and acidified to 10% formic acid.
Following reduction, proteins were alkylated with iodoacetamide (20 mM IAM at room temperature for 30 minutes in the dark) and digested with trypsin at 37 °C.
